title: The models for analyzing and evaluating the financial assets 2

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply models for analyzing and evaluating financial assets such as fixed income, equity, and derivatives.
Apply technical analysis techniques in financial markets using specialized software.
Develop skills in building, estimating, and validating models for financial asset analysis.
Manage investment portfolios using financial models and software tools.
Develop independent learning and group work skills, taking personal and group responsibility.
Apply mathematical models in financial analysis.
Analyze financial data using software tools such as Excel, R, Metastock, and Amibroker.
Manage financial risks using financial models and software tools.
Develop critical thinking skills in financial analysis and decision-making.
Communicate effectively in financial analysis and decision-making.

prerequisite_courses: The models for analyzing and evaluating the financial assets 1
